verdict.rationale: First-party docs say self-hosted Zulip is the same software as Zulip Cloud, with an installer for your own server, no paywalled enterprise features, and export/import tools for moving between Cloud and self-hosted. Community users describe Zulip as 100% FOSS and report running their own instances. Their complaints are about installation friction (a dedicated Debian/Ubuntu machine, weak container support, a 4GB RAM recommendation), which are caveats rather than contradictions. Missing for 10: smooth install across distributions and containers, and lighter resource requirements.
